views.name: phone_recording_pipeline_state
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.tenant_id,
    r.provider,
    r.provider_recording_id,
    r.provider_call_id,
    r.recording_uri,
    r.storage_path,
    r.started_at,
    r.created_at,
    COALESCE(r.started_at, r.created_at) AS sort_at,
    (r.provider_recording_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_provider_id,
    (r.storage_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_download,
    (ct.recording_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_transcript,
    (ins.recording_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_insight,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.storage_path IS NULL) THEN 'download'::text
            WHEN (ct.recording_id IS NULL) THEN 'transcribe'::text
            WHEN (ins.recording_id IS NULL) THEN 'analyse'::text
            ELSE 'complete'::text
        END AS stage,
    ((r.storage_path IS NULL) OR (ct.recording_id IS NULL) OR (ins.recording_id IS NULL)) AS is_incomplete
   FROM ((phone_recordings r
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.recording_id
           FROM phone_transcripts t
          WHERE ((t.recording_id = r.id) AND (t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id) AND (t.status = 'completed'::text))
         LIMIT 1) ct ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.recording_id
           FROM phone_ai_insights i
          WHERE ((i.recording_id = r.id) AND (i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id))
         LIMIT 1) ins ON (true));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_capture_allowed(p_tenant uuid, p_source text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if p_tenant is null or p_source is null or p_source not in ('email','phone','slack') then
  raise exception 'learn_capture_source_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 return exists(select 1 from public.tenants where id=p_tenant and status='active')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.feature_flags where tenant_id=p_tenant

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_capture_control_state(p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 with names(flag) as (values('learn.enabled'),('learn.inputs.email.enabled'),('learn.inputs.phone.enabled'),('learn.inputs.slack.enabled')),
 raw as (select n.flag,f.value,f.tenant_id is not null as present from names n left join public.feature_flags f on f.tenant_id=p_tenant and f.flag=n.flag)
 select jsonb_build_object('version','learn-capture-controls/1','tenant_id',p_tenant,
  'revision',md5((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('flag',flag,'value',value,'present',present) order by flag)::text from raw)),
  'flags',(select jsonb_object_agg(flag,case when jsonb_typeof(value)='boolean' then value else 'null'::jsonb end) from raw),
  'sources',(select jsonb_object_agg(s,jsonb_build_object('allowed',public.learn_capture_allowed(p_tenant,s),
   'inherited',not exists(select 1 from public.feature_flags where tenant_id=p_tenant and flag='learn.inputs.'||s||'.enabled'),
   'invalid',exists(select 1 from public.feature_flags where tenant_id=p_tenant and flag in ('learn.enabled','learn.inputs.'||s||'.enabled') and jsonb_typeof(value) is distinct from 'boolean')))
   from unnest(array['email','phone','slack'])s));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_capture_job_allowed(p_tenant uuid, p_type text, p_metadata jsonb, p_job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select public.learn_capture_job_allowed(p_tenant,p_type,p_metadata)
 or (p_type in ('email.gmail_sync','email.workspace_sync','email.workspace_backfill') and exists(
  select 1 from public.learn_email_job_attempts b
  join public.platform_jobs j on j.id=b.job_id and j.tenant_id=b.tenant_id
  join public.email_sync_runs r on r.id=b.attempt_id and r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id
  where b.job_id=p_job and b.tenant_id=p_tenant and j.job_type=p_type
   and b.definition=jsonb_build_object('job_type',j.job_type,'job_key',j.job_key,'payload',j.payload,'connector_id',j.connector_id,'module_id',j.module_id)
   and r.provider='gmail' and r.sync_type=b.sync_type
   and r.metadata->>'email_account_id'=b.email_account_id::text
   and ((r.status in ('success','failed') and r.completed_at is not null)
    or (r.status='running' and exists(
     select 1 from public.learn_email_transition_requests pending
     where pending.tenant_id=b.tenant_id and pending.email_account_id=b.email_account_id
      and pending.attempt_id=b.attempt_id and pending.stream=b.stream
      and not exists(select 1 from public.learn_email_transition_settlements settled where settled.request_id=pending.id)
    )))
 ));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_email_store_page(p_context jsonb, p_threads jsonb, p_messages jsonb, p_claimed_by text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_claim integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare tenant uuid;thread_count integer;message_count integer;v jsonb;begin
 perform public.learn_email_store_guard(p_context,p_claimed_by,p_claim);
 tenant:=(p_context->>'tenant_id')::uuid;
 if jsonb_typeof(p_threads) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof(p_messages) is distinct from 'array'
  or jsonb_array_length(p_threads)>2000 or jsonb_array_length(p_messages)>2000
  or octet_length(p_threads::text)+octet_length(p_messages::text)>67108864
 then raise exception 'learn_email_store_rows_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 for v in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_threads) loop
  if jsonb_typeof(v) is distinct from 'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(v))<>7
   or not(v ?& array['tenant_id','provider','provider_thread_id','subject','participants','last_message_at','updated_at'])
   or v->>'tenant_id' is distinct from tenant::text or v->>'provider' is distinct from 'gmail'
   or (not coalesce(v->>'provider_thread_id'~'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$',false) or length(v->>'provider_thread_id')>256)
   or jsonb_typeof(v->'participants') is distinct from 'array'
   or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v->'participants')e where jsonb_typeof(e)<>'string')
   or jsonb_typeof(v->'subject') not in ('string','null') or jsonb_typeof(v->'last_message_at') is distinct from 'string'
  then raise exception 'learn_email_store_thread_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 end loop;
 for v in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_messages) loop
  if jsonb_typeof(v) is distinct from 'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(v))<>16
   or not(v ?& array['tenant_id','provider','provider_message_id','provider_thread_id','from_email','from_name','to_emails','cc_emails','subject','snippet','body_text','body_html','sent_at','received_at','direction','raw_payload'])
   or v->>'tenant_id' is distinct from tenant::text or v->>'provider' is distinct from 'gmail'
   or (not coalesce(v->>'provider_message_id'~'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$',false) or length(v->>'provider_message_id')>256)
   or (not coalesce(v->>'provider_thread_id'~'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$',false) or length(v->>'provider_thread_id')>256)
   or jsonb_typeof(v->'to_emails') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof(v->'cc_emails') is distinct from 'array'
   or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((v->'to_emails')||(v->'cc_emails'))e where jsonb_typeof(e)<>'string')
   or jsonb_typeof(v->'raw_payload') is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(v->'direction') is distinct from 'string' or v->>'direction' not in ('inbound','outbound')
   or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(v)e where e.key=any(array['from_email','from_name','subject','snippet','body_text','body_html','sent_at','received_at']) and jsonb_typeof(e.value) not in ('string','null'))
  then raise exception 'learn_email_store_message_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 end loop;
 -- Each thread summary must come from a message in this page and vice versa.
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_messages)m where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_threads)t where t->>'provider_thread_id'=m->>'provider_thread_id'))
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_threads)t where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_messages)m where m->>'provider_thread_id'=t->>'provider_thread_id'))
  or (select count(distinct elem->>'provider_thread_id') from jsonb_array_elements(p_threads)elem)<>jsonb_array_length(p_threads)
  or (select count(distinct elem->>'provider_message_id') from jsonb_array_elements(p_messages)elem)<>jsonb_array_length(p_messages)
 then raise exception 'learn_email_store_page_mismatch' using errcode='22023';end if;
 insert into public.email_threads as retained(tenant_id,provider,provider_thread_id,subject,participants,last_message_at)
 select tenant,'gmail',x.provider_thread_id,x.subject,x.participants,x.last_message_at
 from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.email_threads,p_threads)x order by x.provider_thread_id
 on conflict(tenant_id,provider,provider_thread_id) do update set
  subject=case when retained.last_message_at is null or excluded.last_message_at>retained.last_message_at then coalesce(excluded.subject,retained.subject) else retained.subject end,
  last_message_at=greatest(retained.last_message_at,excluded.last_message_at),
  participants=(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct e order by e),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(retained.participants||excluded.participants)e);
 get diagnostics thread_count=row_count;
 insert into public.email_messages as retained(tenant_id,provider,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,from_email,from_name,to_emails,cc_emails,subject,snippet,body_text,body_html,sent_at,received_at,direction,raw_payload)
 select tenant,'gmail',x.provider_message_id,x.provider_thread_id,x.from_email,x.from_name,x.to_emails,x.cc_emails,x.subject,x.snippet,x.body_text,x.body_html,x.sent_at,x.received_at,x.direction,x.raw_payload
 from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.email_messages,p_messages)x order by x.provider_message_id
 on conflict(tenant_id,provider,provider_message_id) do update set
  provider_thread_id=excluded.provider_thread_id,from_email=coalesce(excluded.from_email,retained.from_email),from_name=coalesce(excluded.from_name,retained.from_name),
  to_emails=excluded.to_emails,cc_emails=excluded.cc_emails,subject=coalesce(excluded.subject,retained.subject),snippet=coalesce(excluded.snippet,retained.snippet),
  body_text=coalesce(excluded.body_text,retained.body_text),body_html=coalesce(excluded.body_html,retained.body_html),sent_at=coalesce(excluded.sent_at,retained.sent_at),received_at=coalesce(excluded.received_at,retained.received_at),direction=excluded.direction,raw_payload=retained.raw_payload||excluded.raw_payload
 where p_context->>'fetch_policy'='refetch_all'
  and case when retained.raw_payload->>'history_id'~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$'
    then case when excluded.raw_payload->>'history_id'~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$'
      then (excluded.raw_payload->>'history_id')::numeric >= (retained.raw_payload->>'history_id')::numeric else false end
    else true end;
 get diagnostics message_count=row_count;
 perform public.learn_email_attempt_lease((p_context->>'attempt_id')::uuid,p_claimed_by,p_claim);
 return jsonb_build_object('version','learn-email-store/1','context',p_context,'message_upsert_count',message_count,'thread_upsert_count',thread_count);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phone_pending_readiness(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(recording_id uuid, stage text, sort_at timestamp with time zone, retry_state text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select s.id, s.stage, s.sort_at,
    public.phone_retry_state(s.stage, coalesce(r.runs,'[]'::jsonb), now())
  from public.phone_recording_pipeline_state s
  left join lateral (
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'status', x.status, 'started_at', x.started_at,
      'failed_step', x.metadata->>'failed_step',
      'error_code', x.metadata->>'error_code'
    ) order by x.started_at desc) runs
    from (
      select status, started_at, metadata from public.phone_sync_runs
      where tenant_id = s.tenant_id and sync_type = 'pipeline'
        and metadata->>'recording_id' = s.id::text
      order by started_at desc limit 5
    ) x
  ) r on true
  where s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id and s.is_incomplete;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phone_select_pending(p_tenant_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 5, p_min_download_age_seconds integer DEFAULT 120)
 RETURNS SETOF phone_recording_pipeline_state
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with eligible as (
    select s.*, s.sort_at >= now()-interval '24 hours' as recent
    from phone_recording_pipeline_state s
    join phone_pending_readiness(p_tenant_id) r on r.recording_id = s.id
    where s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id and r.retry_state = 'ready'
      and (s.stage <> 'download' or public.learn_capture_allowed(p_tenant_id,'phone'))
      and (s.stage <> 'download' or
        (s.has_provider_id and s.sort_at <= now()-make_interval(secs => greatest(0,p_min_download_age_seconds))))
  ), ranked as (
    select id, recent, sort_at,
      row_number() over(partition by recent order by sort_at, id) lane_position
    from eligible
  )
  select s.* from phone_recording_pipeline_state s join ranked r on r.id=s.id
  where s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  order by case
    when r.recent and r.lane_position <= greatest(1,least(50,p_limit)-1) then 0
    when not r.recent and r.lane_position = 1 then 1
    else 2 end, r.sort_at, r.id
  limit greatest(1,least(50,p_limit));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_jobs_claim(p_worker text, p_batch integer DEFAULT 5, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300, p_job_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS SETOF platform_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  update platform_jobs j set
    status           = 'running',
    claimed_at       = now(),
    claimed_by       = p_worker,
    lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => greatest(30, p_lease_seconds)),
    attempt_count    = j.attempt_count + 1,
    last_attempt_at  = now(),
    started_at       = coalesce(j.started_at, now())
  where j.id in (
    select c.id
    from platform_jobs c
    where c.status in ('queued', 'retrying')
      and c.job_type <> 'commusoft.source_sync'
      and c.job_type not in ('slack.history_sync','slack.thread_sync')
      and (c.available_at is null or c.available_at <= now())
      and (c.lease_expires_at is null or c.lease_expires_at < now())
      and (p_job_types is null or c.job_type = any(p_job_types))
      and public.learn_capture_job_allowed(c.tenant_id,c.job_type,c.metadata,c.id)
    order by c.priority asc, c.created_at asc
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(50, p_batch))
  )
  returning j.*;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- Authenticated + existing profile (the join to profiles enforces both: a null
  -- auth.uid() matches no row) + an ACTIVE grant of the required permission.
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    join public.platform_authority_grants g on g.profile_id = p.id
    where p.id = auth.uid()
      and (
        g.permission = required_permission
        or (required_permission = 'platform.controlplane.view'
            and g.permission = 'platform.controlplane.admin')
      )
      and coalesce(g.effective_from, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= now()
      and coalesce(g.effective_to,   'infinity'::timestamptz)  >  now()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_recurring_access(p_tenant uuid, p_write boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select coalesce(auth.uid() is not null and p_tenant is not null and p_write is not null
  and (case when p_write then
   ((p_tenant=public.current_tenant_id() and public.current_user_role() in ('owner','admin'))
     or public.current_user_is_openfolk_operator('platform.controlplane.admin'))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.view_as_context where actor_user_id=auth.uid() and ended_at is null
    and (expires_at is null or expires_at>now()))

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_recurring_read(p_tenant uuid, p_after uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;begin
 if not public.learn_slack_recurring_access(p_tenant,false) then raise exception 'slack_recurring_forbidden' using errcode='42501';end if;
 with candidates as (
  select a.* from public.connector_accounts a join public.tenant_connectors tc on tc.id=a.tenant_connector_id and tc.tenant_id=p_tenant
  where a.tenant_id=p_tenant and tc.connector_id='slack' and (p_after is null or a.id>p_after)
   and a.settings ? 'slack_history' order by a.id limit 51
 ), page as (select * from candidates order by id limit 50), rows as (
  select a.id,jsonb_build_object('accountId',a.id,'name',left(coalesce(a.display_name,'Slack channel'),200),
   'teamId',case when a.settings->'slack_history'->>'teamId' ~ '^T[A-Z0-9]+$' then a.settings->'slack_history'->>'teamId' else null end,
   'channelId',case when a.settings->'slack_history'->>'channelId' ~ '^C[A-Z0-9]+$' then a.settings->'slack_history'->>'channelId' else null end,
   'enabled',coalesce(s.enabled,false),'revision',coalesce(s.revision,0),'state',coalesce(s.last_state,'not_configured'),
   'nextStart',s.next_start,'nextCheckAt',s.next_check_at,'updatedAt',s.updated_at,
   'completeVerified',coalesce(a.sync_cursor->'complete'='true'::jsonb and exists(select 1 from public.platform_jobs j
    where j.tenant_id=p_tenant and j.job_type='slack.history_sync' and j.payload->>'connector_account_id'=a.id::text and j.status='succeeded'
     and j.metadata->'slack_page_v1'->'next'=a.sync_cursor and j.metadata->'slack_page_v1'->>'account_id'=a.id::text),false),
   'threads',public.learn_slack_recurring_threads_status(a.id),
   'pausedWindow',coalesce(not s.enabled and s.current_import is not null
    and a.settings->'slack_history'->>'consentReference'='learn-slack-import:'||s.current_import::text
    and a.settings->'slack_history'->'approved'='false'::jsonb,false)
  ) as item from page a left join public.slack_recurring_channels s on s.account_id=a.id and s.tenant_id=p_tenant
 ) select jsonb_build_object('version','learn-slack-recurring/1','tenantId',p_tenant,
  'canWrite',public.learn_slack_recurring_access(p_tenant,true),'channels',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(item order by id) from rows),'[]'),
  'next',case when (select count(*) from candidates)>50 then (select id from page order by id desc limit 1) else null end)
 into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_recurring_thread_allowed(p_tenant uuid, p_import uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.slack_thread_imports t where t.id=p_import and t.tenant_id=p_tenant
 and (not (t.definition ? 'recurringHistoryImportId') or exists(
  select 1 from public.slack_recurring_channels s
  join public.provider_connections c on c.id=s.connection_id and c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id
  join public.profiles p on p.id=t.approved_by
  where s.account_id=t.account_id and s.tenant_id=p_tenant and s.enabled and s.include_threads
  and s.thread_revision=(t.definition->>'recurringRevision')::bigint
  and c.updated_at=s.connection_revision and c.updated_at=(t.definition->>'connectionRevision')::timestamptz
  and c.status='configured' and c.revoked_at is null and c.provider='slack'
  and public.learn_capture_allowed(p_tenant,'slack')
  and ((p.tenant_id=p_tenant and p.role in ('owner','admin')) or exists(select 1 from public.platform_authority_grants g
   where g.profile_id=p.id and g.permission='platform.controlplane.admin'
   and coalesce(g.effective_from,'-infinity')<=now() and coalesce(g.effective_to,'infinity')>now())))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_recurring_thread_window_complete(p_window uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select coalesce(p->'discoveryComplete'='true'::jsonb and p->'observed'=p->'completed',false)
 from public.learn_slack_recurring_thread_window_progress(p_window) p;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_recurring_thread_window_progress(p_window uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 with recursive lineage(root,id,tenant_id,account_id,scope,definition,checkpoint,approved_at) as (
  select m.thread_import_id,t.id,t.tenant_id,t.account_id,t.scope,t.definition,t.checkpoint,t.approved_at
  from public.slack_recurring_thread_members m join public.slack_thread_imports t on t.id=m.thread_import_id where m.history_import_id=p_window
  union
  select l.root,t.id,t.tenant_id,t.account_id,t.scope,t.definition,t.checkpoint,t.approved_at
  from lineage l join public.slack_thread_imports t on t.definition->>'resumesImportId'=l.id::text
  and t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id and t.account_id=l.account_id
  and t.definition->>'recurringHistoryImportId'=p_window::text
  and t.scope->>'parentTimestamp'=l.scope->>'parentTimestamp'
  and t.scope->>'oldest'=l.scope->>'oldest' and t.scope->>'latest'=l.scope->>'latest'
 ), latest as (select distinct on(root) * from lineage order by root,approved_at desc,id desc)
 select jsonb_build_object('discoveryComplete',(select discovery_complete from public.slack_recurring_thread_windows where history_import_id=p_window),
 'observed',(select count(*) from latest),'completed',(select count(*) from latest t where t.checkpoint->'complete'='true'::jsonb and exists(
  select 1 from public.platform_jobs j where j.tenant_id=t.tenant_id and j.job_type='slack.thread_sync' and j.status='succeeded'
  and j.payload->>'thread_import_id'=t.id::text and j.metadata->'slack_page_v1'->'next'=t.checkpoint
  and j.metadata->'slack_page_v1'->>'thread_import_id'=t.id::text)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_recurring_threads_status(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('enabled',coalesce(s.include_threads,false),'canEnable',coalesce(s.enabled and w.history_import_id is null,false),
 'discoveryComplete',case when w.history_import_id is not null then w.discovery_complete else null end,
 'observed',case when w.history_import_id is not null then progress->'observed' else 'null'::jsonb end,
 'completed',case when w.history_import_id is not null then progress->'completed' else 'null'::jsonb end)
 from (select 1) seed left join public.slack_recurring_channels s on s.account_id=p_account
 left join public.slack_recurring_thread_windows w on w.history_import_id=s.current_import
 left join lateral public.learn_slack_recurring_thread_window_progress(w.history_import_id) progress on true;
$function$

views.name: phone_recording_pipeline_state
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.tenant_id,
    r.provider,
    r.provider_recording_id,
    r.provider_call_id,
    r.recording_uri,
    r.storage_path,
    r.started_at,
    r.created_at,
    COALESCE(r.started_at, r.created_at) AS sort_at,
    (r.provider_recording_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_provider_id,
    (r.storage_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_download,
    (ct.recording_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_transcript,
    (ins.recording_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_insight,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.storage_path IS NULL) THEN 'download'::text
            WHEN (ct.recording_id IS NULL) THEN 'transcribe'::text
            WHEN (ins.recording_id IS NULL) THEN 'analyse'::text
            ELSE 'complete'::text
        END AS stage,
    ((r.storage_path IS NULL) OR (ct.recording_id IS NULL) OR (ins.recording_id IS NULL)) AS is_incomplete
   FROM ((phone_recordings r
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.recording_id
           FROM phone_transcripts t
          WHERE ((t.recording_id = r.id) AND (t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id) AND (t.status = 'completed'::text))
         LIMIT 1) ct ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.recording_id
           FROM phone_ai_insights i
          WHERE ((i.recording_id = r.id) AND (i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id))
         LIMIT 1) ins ON (true));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_commusoft_claim_jobs(p_worker uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF platform_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare j public.platform_jobs%rowtype;begin
 if auth.role() is distinct from 'service_role' then raise exception 'commusoft_queue_forbidden' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if p_worker is null or current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' then raise exception 'commusoft_queue_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 for j in select * from public.platform_jobs q where q.job_type='commusoft.source_sync'
   and q.status in ('queued','retrying','running') and coalesce(q.available_at,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp()
   and coalesce(q.lease_expires_at,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp()
   order by q.priority,q.created_at,q.id for update skip locked limit 1
 loop
   if j.attempt_count is null or j.attempt_count<0 or j.max_attempts is null or j.max_attempts<1 or
     (j.attempt_count>=j.max_attempts and not exists(select 1 from public.learn_business_input_pages p where p.job_id=j.id and p.tenant_id=j.tenant_id)) then
     update public.platform_jobs set status='dead_letter',dead_lettered_at=clock_timestamp(),failed_at=clock_timestamp(),
       lease_expires_at=null,error_code='commusoft_attempts_exhausted' where id=j.id;
   else
     update public.platform_jobs set status='running',claimed_by='learn-commusoft:'||p_worker::text,
       claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '180 seconds',
       attempt_count=j.attempt_count+1,last_attempt_at=clock_timestamp(),started_at=coalesce(started_at,clock_timestamp())
       where id=j.id returning * into j;
     return next j;
   end if;
 end loop;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_operator_inputs(p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare connections jsonb;accounts jsonb;begin
 perform public.learn_operator_input_access(p_tenant,auth.uid(),false);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.row order by x.id),'[]') into connections from (
  select c.id,jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'status',c.status,'revision',c.updated_at,'verified_at',c.verified_at,'revoked',c.revoked_at is not null,
   'account_key',left(c.non_secret_config->>'account_key',2000),'region',c.non_secret_config->>'region',
   'credential_bound',exists(select 1 from vault.secrets s where s.id::text=c.secret_refs->>'api_key' and s.name='provider_secret:'||p_tenant::text||':commusoft:api_key')) as row
  from public.provider_connections c where c.tenant_id=p_tenant and c.provider='commusoft' order by c.id limit 21
 ) x;
 if jsonb_array_length(connections)>20 then raise exception 'learn_operator_connection_limit' using errcode='54000';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.row order by x.id),'[]') into accounts from (
  select a.id,jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'status',a.status,'connector_enabled',tc.enabled and tc.status='active',
   'connection_id',a.settings->'commusoft_import'->>'connectionId','resource',a.settings->'commusoft_import'->>'resource',
   'approval_id',a.settings->'commusoft_import'->>'approvalId','expires_at',a.settings->'commusoft_import'->>'expiresAt',
   'contact_target_count',a.settings->'commusoft_import'->'contactTargetCount','max_pages',a.settings->'commusoft_import'->'maxPages','checkpoint',(jsonb_build_object('approvalId',a.sync_cursor->'approvalId','pages',a.sync_cursor->'pages','after',a.sync_cursor->'after','complete',a.sync_cursor->'complete')||case when a.sync_cursor ? 'propertyId' then jsonb_build_object('propertyId',a.sync_cursor->'propertyId','propertiesCompleted',a.sync_cursor->'propertiesCompleted') else '{}'::jsonb end),
   'latest_job',(select jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'status',j.status,'error_code',
    case when j.error_code~'^commusoft_[a-z_]{1,80}$' then j.error_code when j.error_code is not null then 'commusoft_worker_failed' end,
    'attempt_count',j.attempt_count,'available_at',j.available_at,'lease_expires_at',j.lease_expires_at,'completed_at',j.completed_at,
    'stop_reason',case when j.result->>'stop_reason' in ('collection_exhausted','page_budget_exhausted','next_page','authorisation_changed') then j.result->>'stop_reason' end)
    from public.platform_jobs j where j.tenant_id=p_tenant and j.job_type='commusoft.source_sync' and j.payload->>'connector_account_id'=a.id::text order by j.created_at desc,j.id desc limit 1)) as row
  from public.connector_accounts a join public.tenant_connectors tc on tc.id=a.tenant_connector_id and tc.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
  where a.tenant_id=p_tenant and tc.connector_id='commusoft' and tc.provider='commusoft' order by a.id limit 21
 ) x;
 if jsonb_array_length(accounts)>20 then raise exception 'learn_operator_account_limit' using errcode='54000';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('tenant_id',p_tenant,'checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'flags',public.learn_operator_input_flags(p_tenant),'connections',connections,'accounts',accounts);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_operator_capture_health(p_tenant uuid, p_after text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare rows jsonb;more boolean;last_key text;begin
 perform public.learn_operator_input_access(p_tenant,auth.uid(),false);
 if p_after is not null and p_after!~'^(email|phone|slack):[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then
  raise exception 'learn_operator_health_cursor_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 with candidates as (
  select 'email:'||a.id::text as key,jsonb_build_object(
   'id',a.id,'source','email','provider',case when a.provider='gmail' and a.status in ('active_dwd','pending_tokenless_dwd') then 'google_workspace' when a.provider in ('gmail','google_workspace') then a.provider else 'other_email' end,
   'label',left(coalesce(nullif(a.display_name,''),'Mailbox'),120),
   'enabled',null,'account_state',case when a.status in ('active','active_dwd','pending_tokenless_dwd','disabled','paused','revoked') then a.status else 'unknown' end,
   'auth_state',case when a.status in ('active_dwd','pending_tokenless_dwd') or a.provider='google_workspace' then 'unknown' when a.auth_state in ('ok','expired','revoked','needs_reconnect') then a.auth_state else 'unknown' end,
   'last_success_at',greatest(a.last_incremental_success_at,case when er.status='success' and er.completed_at>=er.started_at then er.completed_at end),
   'last_attempt_at',greatest(a.last_incremental_attempt_at,er.started_at),
   'last_failure_at',greatest(
    case when a.last_sync_error is not null and a.last_incremental_attempt_at>=coalesce(a.last_incremental_success_at,'-infinity') then a.last_incremental_attempt_at end,
    case when er.status='failed' then coalesce(er.completed_at,er.started_at)
     when er.status='success' and (er.completed_at is null or er.completed_at<er.started_at) then er.started_at end),
   'latest_job',null,'bounded_complete',null) as row
  from public.email_accounts a
  left join lateral (
   select r.status,r.started_at,r.completed_at from public.email_sync_runs r
   where a.provider in ('gmail','google_workspace') and r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
    and r.metadata->>'email_account_id'=a.id::text and r.provider='gmail'
    and r.sync_type in ('messages','workspace_messages')
    and r.sync_type=case when a.provider='google_workspace' or a.status in ('active_dwd','pending_tokenless_dwd') then 'workspace_messages' else 'messages' end
    and r.status in ('success','failed')
   order by r.started_at desc,r.id desc limit 1
  ) er on true
  where a.tenant_id=p_tenant
  union all
  select (case when tc.connector_id='slack' then 'slack:' else 'phone:' end)||a.id::text as key,jsonb_build_object(
   'id',a.id,'source',case when tc.connector_id='slack' then 'slack' else 'phone' end,'provider',tc.connector_id,
   'label',left(coalesce(nullif(a.display_name,''),case when tc.connector_id='slack' then 'Slack channel' else 'Phone account' end),120),
   'enabled',tc.enabled and (case when tc.connector_id='slack' then tc.status='active' else tc.status in ('active','error') end),
   'account_state',case when a.status in ('active','disabled','paused','revoked') then a.status else 'unknown' end,
   'auth_state','unknown','last_success_at',a.last_successful_sync_at,'last_attempt_at',null,'last_failure_at',a.last_failed_sync_at,
   'latest_job',case when j.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,
    'status',case when j.status in ('queued','running','retrying','succeeded','dead_letter','cancelled') then j.status else 'unknown' end,
    'available_at',j.available_at,'lease_expires_at',j.lease_expires_at,'completed_at',j.completed_at) end,
   'phone_evidence',case when tc.connector_id='simwood' then public.learn_phone_account_evidence(p_tenant,a.id) else null end,
   'bounded_complete',case when tc.connector_id='slack' then coalesce(
    j.status='succeeded' and j.completed_at is not null
    and j.result->>'stopReason'='window_pages_complete'
    and j.result->'complete'='true'::jsonb and a.sync_cursor->'complete'='true'::jsonb
    and jsonb_typeof(a.sync_cursor->'scopeKey')='string' and a.sync_cursor->>'scopeKey'<>''
    and j.result->'scopeKey'=a.sync_cursor->'scopeKey'
    and j.result->'pages'=a.sync_cursor->'pages',false) else null end) as row
  from public.connector_accounts a join public.tenant_connectors tc on tc.id=a.tenant_connector_id and tc.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
  left join lateral(select q.id,q.status,q.available_at,q.lease_expires_at,q.completed_at,q.result from public.platform_jobs q
   where tc.connector_id='slack' and q.tenant_id=p_tenant and q.job_type='slack.history_sync' and q.payload->>'connector_account_id'=a.id::text
   order by q.created_at desc,q.id desc limit 1) j on true
  where a.tenant_id=p_tenant and ((tc.connector_id='simwood' and tc.provider='simwood') or (tc.connector_id='slack' and tc.provider='slack'))
 ), bounded as (select * from candidates where p_after is null or key>p_after order by key limit 51), page as (select * from bounded order by key limit 50)
 select coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row||jsonb_build_object('key',key) order by key) from page),'[]'),
  (select count(*)>50 from bounded),(select key from page order by key desc limit 1) into rows,more,last_key;
 return jsonb_build_object('version','learn-operator-capture-health/1','tenant_id',p_tenant,'checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'phone_processing',public.learn_phone_processing_evidence(p_tenant),'rows',rows,'next_cursor',case when more then last_key else null end);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_phone_account_evidence(p_tenant uuid, p_account uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 with account as (
  select a.*,c.id as connector from public.connector_accounts a join public.tenant_connectors c
   on c.id=a.tenant_connector_id and c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
  where a.id=p_account and a.tenant_id=p_tenant and c.connector_id='simwood' and c.provider='simwood'
 ), attempts as not materialized (
  select r.*,s.receipt,q.id as job_id,q.status as job_status,q.lease_expires_at,
   coalesce(q.status='running' and q.claimed_by=r.metadata->>'job_owner' and q.attempt_count=1 and q.lease_expires_at>now()
    and q.connector_id='simwood' and q.payload->>'provider_customer_id'=r.metadata->>'provider_customer_id'
    and q.payload->>'from'=r.metadata->>'from' and q.payload->>'to'=r.metadata->>'to'
    and r.metadata->>'tenant_connector_id'=a.connector::text
    and r.metadata->'include_local'=to_jsonb(coalesce(a.settings->'include_local_calls'='true'::jsonb,false)),false) as ownership_current,
   coalesce(s.tenant_id=p_tenant and s.receipt->>'version'='learn-phone-schedule/1'
    and s.receipt->>'tenantId'=p_tenant::text and s.receipt->>'runId'=r.id::text
    and s.receipt->>'accountId'=a.id::text and s.receipt->>'connectorId'=a.connector::text
    and s.receipt->>'customerId'=coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.settings->>'provider_customer_id'),''),a.account_key)
    and r.metadata->>'tenant_connector_id'=a.connector::text
    and r.metadata->'include_local'=to_jsonb(coalesce(a.settings->'include_local_calls'='true'::jsonb,false))
    and s.receipt->>'outcome'=r.status and s.receipt->>'jobId'=q.id::text
    and q.connector_id='simwood' and q.attempt_count=1
    and q.payload->>'provider_customer_id'=r.metadata->>'provider_customer_id'
    and q.payload->>'from'=r.metadata->>'from' and q.payload->>'to'=r.metadata->>'to'
    and s.receipt->>'from'=r.metadata->>'from' and s.receipt->>'to'=r.metadata->>'to'
    and q.completed_at=r.completed_at
    and r.completed_at is not null and r.completed_at>=r.started_at
    and ((r.status='success' and q.status='succeeded' and s.receipt->'cursorAdvanced'='true'::jsonb)
     or (r.status='failed' and q.status='failed' and s.receipt->'cursorAdvanced'='false'::jsonb)
     or (r.status='paused' and q.status='cancelled' and s.receipt->'cursorAdvanced'='false'::jsonb)),false) as confirmed
  from account a join public.phone_sync_runs r on r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and r.provider='simwood' and r.sync_type='scheduled_sync'
   and r.metadata->>'connector_account_id'=a.id::text
   and r.metadata->>'provider_customer_id'=coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.settings->>'provider_customer_id'),''),a.account_key)
  left join public.learn_phone_schedule_settlements s on s.run_id=r.id and s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
  left join public.platform_jobs q on q.id=case when r.metadata->>'job_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then (r.metadata->>'job_id')::uuid end
   and q.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and q.job_type='phone.scheduled_sync'
 ), latest as (select * from attempts order by started_at desc,id desc limit 1),
 successful as (select * from attempts where confirmed and status='success' order by started_at desc,id desc limit 1)
 select jsonb_build_object('version','learn-phone-account-evidence/1','tenant_id',p_tenant,'account_id',p_account,
  'scope','scheduled_capture','capture_allowed',public.learn_capture_allowed(p_tenant,'phone'),
  'latest_attempt',(select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'status',case when status in ('running','success','failed','paused') then status else 'unknown' end,
   'started_at',started_at,'completed_at',completed_at,'confirmed',confirmed,
   'job',case when job_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',job_id,'status',case when job_status in ('queued','running','retrying','succeeded','failed','dead_letter','cancelled') then job_status else 'unknown' end,
    'lease_expires_at',lease_expires_at,'ownership_current',ownership_current) end) from latest),
  'last_confirmed',(select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'completed_at',completed_at,'from',receipt->>'from','to',receipt->>'to',
   'calls_processed',receipt->'callsProcessed','recordings_processed',receipt->'recordingsProcessed') from successful));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_phone_processing_evidence(p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 with source as materialized (select * from public.phone_recording_pipeline_state where tenant_id=p_tenant),
 readiness as materialized (select * from public.phone_pending_readiness(p_tenant)),
 counts as (select count(*)::int as total,count(*) filter(where s.stage='complete')::int as complete,
  count(*) filter(where s.stage='download')::int as download_pending,
  count(*) filter(where s.stage='transcribe')::int as transcribe_pending,
  count(*) filter(where s.stage='analyse')::int as analyse_pending,
  count(*) filter(where r.retry_state='needs_review')::int as needs_review,
  count(*) filter(where r.retry_state='cooldown')::int as cooling_down,
  count(*) filter(where r.retry_state='in_progress')::int as recent_processing,
  count(*) filter(where r.retry_state='ready' and (s.stage<>'download' or (s.has_provider_id and s.sort_at<=now()-interval '120 seconds')))::int as ready,
  count(*) filter(where r.retry_state='ready' and s.stage='download' and (not s.has_provider_id or s.sort_at>now()-interval '120 seconds'))::int as waiting_provider,
  count(*) filter(where s.is_incomplete and (r.retry_state is null or r.retry_state not in ('needs_review','cooldown','in_progress','ready')))::int as unknown_retry
  from source s left join readiness r on r.recording_id=s.id)
 select jsonb_build_object('version','learn-phone-processing-evidence/1','tenant_id',p_tenant,'scope','company')||to_jsonb(counts) from counts;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phone_pending_readiness(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(recording_id uuid, stage text, sort_at timestamp with time zone, retry_state text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select s.id, s.stage, s.sort_at,
    public.phone_retry_state(s.stage, coalesce(r.runs,'[]'::jsonb), now())
  from public.phone_recording_pipeline_state s
  left join lateral (
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'status', x.status, 'started_at', x.started_at,
      'failed_step', x.metadata->>'failed_step',
      'error_code', x.metadata->>'error_code'
    ) order by x.started_at desc) runs
    from (
      select status, started_at, metadata from public.phone_sync_runs
      where tenant_id = s.tenant_id and sync_type = 'pipeline'
        and metadata->>'recording_id' = s.id::text
      order by started_at desc limit 5
    ) x
  ) r on true
  where s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id and s.is_incomplete;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_commusoft_review_page(p_tenant uuid, p_connection uuid, p_after text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;more boolean;last_id text;begin
 if p_connection is null or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 or
  (p_after is not null and p_after!~'^[0-9]{1,16}$') then raise exception 'business_input_page_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 perform public.learn_business_input_review_access(p_tenant,p_connection);
 with identities as (
  select distinct external_id from public.learn_business_input_versions
  where tenant_id=p_tenant and connection_id=p_connection and provider='commusoft' and collection='properties'
   and (p_after is null or external_id collate "C">p_after collate "C")
 ), latest as (
  select s.*,l.id as link_id,l.entity_table,l.entity_id,l.card_id,l.source_version_id as linked_version
  from identities i cross join lateral (
   select v.id,v.external_id,v.payload,p.committed_at from public.learn_business_input_versions v
   join public.learn_business_input_observations o on o.version_id=v.id join public.learn_business_input_pages p on p.id=o.page_id
   where v.tenant_id=p_tenant and v.connection_id=p_connection and v.provider='commusoft' and v.collection='properties' and v.external_id=i.external_id
    and p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id and p.connection_id=v.connection_id and p.provider=v.provider and p.collection=v.collection
   order by p.committed_at desc,v.id limit 1
  ) s left join public.learn_business_input_links l on l.tenant_id=p_tenant and l.connection_id=p_connection
    and l.provider='commusoft' and l.collection='properties' and l.external_id=s.external_id
  where s.payload->>'type'='customer' or l.entity_kind='customer'
 ), bounded as (select * from latest order by external_id collate "C" limit p_limit+1), output as (
  select *,row_number() over(order by external_id collate "C") as n from bounded
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version_id',id,'external_id',external_id,'observed_at',committed_at,
   'summary',public.learn_business_customer_summary(payload),
   'link',case when link_id is not null then jsonb_build_object('entity_table',entity_table,'entity_id',entity_id,'card_id',card_id,'source_version_id',linked_version) end)
   order by external_id collate "C") filter(where n<=p_limit),'[]'),count(*)>p_limit,
   max(external_id collate "C") filter(where n<=p_limit) into result,more,last_id from output;
 return jsonb_build_object('tenant_id',p_tenant,'connection_id',p_connection,'rows',result,'next_cursor',case when more then last_id end);
end $function$
